protocol.basis: version field of the IKE header

exchange_mode.basis: exchange type in the IKE header

ipsec_mode.basis: encapsulation mode attribute of the quick mode proposal

encryption.basis: encryption attribute of the IKE proposal

authentication.basis: integrity attribute of the quick mode proposal

hash.basis: hash attribute of the IKE proposal

dh_group.basis: group attribute of the IKE proposal

key_exchange.basis: derived from the DH group number

auth_method.basis: authentication attribute of the IKE proposal

lifetime_seconds.basis: life duration attribute of the IKE proposal

pfs_enabled.basis: the quick mode proposal includes a DH group

replay_protection.basis: ESP sequence numbers increased monotonically across 34 packets; the receiver's replay window itself is not visible on the wire

nat_traversal.basis: IKE was seen only on UDP/500 in this capture

identity_exposed.basis: main mode sends identities encrypted, and none was seen in the clear

traffic_features.basis: measured from 34 ESP/AH packets (sizes and timing only)

findings.issue: AES in CBC mode negotiated (AES-128-CBC): prefer an AEAD mode such as AES-GCM
findings.evidence: IKE transform payload advertised AES-128-CBC; CBC requires a separate integrity algorithm and is more error-prone than AES-GCM
findings.evidence_basis: encryption: encryption attribute of the IKE proposal

findings.evidence: IKE transform payload advertised SHA1 for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20
findings.evidence_basis: hash: hash attribute of the IKE proposal

findings.issue: Weak Diffie-Hellman group negotiated: group 5 (1536-bit MODP)
findings.evidence: IKE key exchange payload indicated DH group 5 for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20
findings.evidence_basis: dh_group: group attribute of the IKE proposal

findings.issue: Deprecated key exchange protocol in use: IKEv1
findings.evidence: ISAKMP header reported version 1.0 for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20
findings.evidence_basis: protocol: version field of the IKE header

findings.issue: SA lifetime below the recommended minimum: 120s (< 300s)
findings.evidence: IKE SA lifetime attribute decoded as 120 seconds for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20; excessive rekeying destabilises the tunnel
findings.evidence_basis: lifetime_seconds: life duration attribute of the IKE proposal

findings.issue: Transport mode in use for what appears to be a site-to-site SA
findings.evidence: ESP payload structure for session 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8:100::20 is consistent with transport mode; the inner IP header is therefore not protected
findings.evidence_basis: ipsec_mode: encapsulation mode attribute of the quick mode proposal

findings.issue: Negotiated cipher suite is not compliant with the approved baseline
findings.evidence: Suite AES-128-CBC/SHA1/DH5 fails the AES-GCM or AES-256 + SHA-256 baseline: cipher AES-128-CBC does not meet the AES-256 minimum for non-AEAD modes
findings.evidence_basis: encryption: encryption attribute of the IKE proposal
